text: res list structure containing simulation results plotted. length main list indicates number separate plots make. list entry list, corresponds one plot needs contain following information/elements:  1. data frame list element called "dat" "ts". data frame "ts" assumed time series default line plot produced labeled Time/Numbers. plotting, data needs format one column called xvals, one column yvals, one column called varnames contains names different variables. Varnames needs factor variable converted one. column 'varnames' exist, assumed data right format. Otherwise transformed. optional column called IDvar can provided grouping (.e. multiple lines stochastic simulations). plottype 'mixedplot' additional column called 'style' indicating line point plot variable needed.  2. Meta-data plot, provided following variables:  optional: plottype - One "Lineplot" (default nothing provided),"Scatterplot","Boxplot", "Mixedplot".  optional: xlab, ylab - Strings label axes.  optional: xscale, yscale - Scaling axes, valid ggplot2 expression, e.g. "identity" "log10".  optional: xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax - Manual min max axes.  optional: makelegend - TRUE/FALSE, add legend plot. Assume true provided.  optional: legendtitle - Legend title, NULL/supplied, default used  optional: legendlocation - "left" specified, top left. Otherwise top.  optional: linesize - Width line, numeric, .e. 1.5, 2, etc. set 1.5 supplied.  optional: pallette - overwrite plot colors providing vector color names hex numbers used plot.  optional: title - title plot.  optional: multiple plots, specify res[[1]]$ncols define number columns
